notes: Entry is operationally pinned ('previous bar <= -80 and current bar > -80' plus 'Momentum > 0', mirrored for shorts) with explicit periods (W%R 14, Momentum 14, ATR 14), and the binding is coherent: prose says '5-minute AAPL bars' and the bench binds AAPL 5m (AAPL_5m.pkl, 4680 rows, 2026-04-15 to 2026-07-10). The killer is the ATR stop: 'an adjustable multiple (atr_mult)' is named but never given a value, so implementers must invent atr_mult (1.5/2.0/3.0), which directly moves stop levels and trades; the stop's execution mechanism (Stop order at the level vs bar-close check + market close) is also unspecified, changing fill timestamps. 'Close an open position when an opposite entry signal occurs' combined with 'Go SHORT when...' leaves reverse-vs-close-only and same-bar re-entry mechanics unpinned under the (timestamp, side) tape key. The stated default 'static from entry (default)' pins the stop mode itself, and -80/-20 are indicator thresholds, not price levels, so hardcoded_prices_meaningful is vacuously true.
